title: Camille Fournier
extract: Camille Fournier is known for being the former chief technology officer of Rent The Runway, former vice president of technology at Goldman Sachs, a former managing director at JPMorgan Chase, and author of The Manager's Path: A Guide for Tech Leaders Navigating Growth and Change. She is currently the VP Engineering of Common Services at CoreWeave.
